To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) perceived need for health information was positively associated with non-adherence to antihypertensive treatment, (b) the association between need and non-adherence was mediated by perceived barriers to health information acquisition, (c) need and barriers were not associated with adherence to healthy behaviours and (d) perceived need was positively associated with perceived barriers to health behaviour acquisition
